_comment: What docs/features/code-refs.md (draft, 2026-10-10) says the code walk, the binding library and `spec refs` give on this corpus (TE-1). `markers`: every marker of the walked files, in walk order (byte-sorted paths, then line); `row` is the marker's `spec refs` text row (`relation | path:line:column | token | id_state[ fix] | rev_state | levels | binding[ | note]`, split on ` | `) under each node of `listed_under` (none: the library alone sees it); `binding_line` the bound item's first line. `rule` names the binding rule or category the row covers, `mutation` the named test whose mutation turns it red. `mentions`: every comment citation, sorted as refs prints them. `generated`: files a test writes into its temp copy (raw Cyrillic stays out of the repository, ADR-0024), with their rows; `rows_by_holder` where one marker names several nodes. `crlf`: the same rows with every LF of the walked files turned to CRLF. `open`: readings of the draft to reconcile once the code lands. Derived, not repeated: the JSON marker's `id` is the token up to its first `@`, `rev` the 1-9 digits after it ending the token (else null); `levels` `default` -> [sig, body] / `default`, `[a, b]` -> [a, b] / `declared`, `invalid:<c>` -> null / `<c>`; the JSON `binding` splits the text form (kind, qpath, item_kind, ambiguity, category) and takes `line` from `binding_line`. `spec refs <ID>` prints, per holder, the node's `header`, its `row`s ordered by relation (implements, verifies, configures, assumes), path bytes, line, column, then its mention rows, blocks apart by an empty line, then the summary (`refs_stdout_example`).

open: bad_rev ids (counter.rs:34 GOAL-01@, :41 GOAL-01@1234567890, :45 LAW-BOUND@3a): id_state read as `resolved` -- the ID is the token up to `@`, read by parse_reference; JSON rev null; no note (today's parser leaves `@` as the note of `GOAL-01@`).

module bindings of crate roots render the package (and unit) alone: lib.rs `module crates/tally`, tests/bounds.rs `module crates/tally::test:bounds`; an inline mod `module crates/tally::counter::inner`. The draft shows only `src/a.rs` -> `<pkg>::a`.
a file outside every package (tools/loose.rs) takes the eval's package label `.`: item `.::seed`, module `.`, both ` ambiguous unrooted`.

JSON binding `line`: an item's node start (attributes are siblings, excluded: tests/bounds.rs:4 -> 6, not the `#[test]` line 5); null for module, ron, unanchored, cannot_verify and file; cannot_verify keeps qpath and item_kind null.
JSON marker `id` is the token's ID part as written: `AIM-01` (alias), the Cyrillic-led ID (homoglyph), `PIECE-COUNTER#LAW-BOUND`, `cap-check/PASS-01`, `other:GOAL-01`, `` (empty).
LAW-ODD (`rev=0`): node rev null, rev_written true, header `rev unknown`; its marker counter.rs:56 `LAW-ODD@1` is `rev_unknown` although its id is `resolved`.
code.skipped counts only content (and names) that are not UTF-8: the `.`-name and the excluded file are neither files nor skipped.

not in the fixture, a draft question: an inner doc comment (`//!`) on its own line directly above an item -- rule 2 (first that applies) binds the item, rule 5 / rustdoc the module. Every `//!` here is followed by `use` or `#![..]`, so no row depends on it.
not in the fixture: a mention in an unanchored RON comment (`the innermost enclosing item` has no RON reading).
a mention inside a marker's note (counter.rs:4 `see LAW-STEP`) counts and belongs to `file`: the marker comment is unanchored at file level.
`PIECE-COUNTER#LAW-BOUND@2` (counter.rs:48) is listed under LAW-BOUND only, never under PIECE-COUNTER (`not its sections or parents`).
JSON binding qpath of a RON anchor is `<path>#<field path>` (`data/limits.ron#root.cap`), as the text row.
generated GOAL-03 (two holders): one marker, a block per holder with its own rev_state (current under rev 2, predated under the unwritten rev 1); the summary counts the rows printed (markers 2).
cannot_verify category of broken.rs `let x = 1 2;` is `other`, as the same construct in fixtures/ast-hash/src/broken.rs.
